Challenge 1: The Loop Master.title: Time Trial: The Infinite Loop
Challenge 1: The Loop Master.description:
Construct a 'while' loop that runs exactly 5 times. Inside the loop, print 'Tick'. 

Hint: Use a counter variable starting at 0.
Challenge 1: The Loop Master.success_msg: Time stabilizes! You have mastered the flow of time.
Challenge 1: The Loop Master.error_hint: Make sure your loop runs exactly 5 times and prints 'Tick' on a new line each time.

Challenge 2: The Math Wizard.title: Boss: The Fibonacci Gate
Challenge 2: The Math Wizard.description: Calculate the sum of 10 + 20 + 30 using variables. Create three variables a=10, b=20, c=30. Print the sum.
Challenge 2: The Math Wizard.success_msg: The gate shatters! Your math logic is undeniable.
Challenge 2: The Math Wizard.error_hint: Create the variables first, then print(a + b + c).
